measure_name: Ensure cybersecurity of digital payment platforms and mobile money rails
definition: Protect payment switches, mobile money platforms, and interbank systems from cyber threats that could disrupt access to funds during crises. Includes penetration testing, security operations centers, incident response protocols.

measure_name: Build redundancy in payment processing infrastructure with backup and failover systems
definition: Backup payment processing centers, mirror databases, and automatic failover so G2P transfers and mobile money continue if primary systems fail.

measure_name: Strengthen mobile money agent network resilience for cash-out during disruptions
definition: Agent networks continue operating when infrastructure is degraded - agent liquidity management, portable POS with offline capability, geographic diversification.

measure_name: Protect digital land registries and property records from data loss
definition: Digitized land titles, cadastral records and property databases backed up and recoverable after disasters.

measure_name: Deploy shock-responsive G2P digital payment systems linked to national ID and social registries
definition: Rapid cash transfers to affected populations using pre-registered beneficiary databases and digital payment channels.

measure_name: Enable digital credit, savings, and microinsurance products to build household liquidity buffers
definition: Accessible digital financial products helping households and small firms accumulate savings and access credit before shocks.

measure_name: Scale mobile money for post-disaster person-to-person remittances
definition: Leverage existing mobile money networks for informal transfers between households during and after crises.

measure_name: Digitize land registries and property records to protect asset ownership through crises
definition: Convert paper land titles and cadastral records to digital systems enabling verification of property rights after disasters.

measure_name: Establish data protection and consent protocols for beneficiary registries used in emergency disbursements
definition: Safeguards for personal and financial data collected through social registries.

measure_name: Design interoperability and portability standards for digital financial services
definition: Prevent beneficiary lock-in to single payment providers.

measure_name: Address algorithmic fairness and gender exclusion risks in social protection targeting systems
definition: Audit frameworks ensuring digital targeting systems do not systematically exclude vulnerable populations.

measure_name: Establish financial consumer protection frameworks for digital lending during crises
definition: Safeguards against predatory digital lending practices that surge during economic shocks.

measure_name: Build redundant communication networks with satellite backup and diverse routing for early warning dissemination
definition: Warning messages reach populations even if primary telecom is damaged. Satellite backhaul, mesh networks, multi-path fiber routing.

measure_name: Harden weather monitoring sensors, IoT devices, and satellite ground stations against physical hazards
definition: Protect weather stations, river gauges, seismic sensors, satellite ground stations. Flood-proofing, battery backup, vandalism-hardened housings.

measure_name: Deploy satellite-based telemetry as backup for hydromet observation networks
definition: Supplement GSM-dependent data transmission from remote weather stations with satellite telemetry.

measure_name: Deploy multi-channel early warning dissemination combining cell broadcast, SMS, apps, and radio
definition: Reach populations through multiple channels to maximize coverage and redundancy.

measure_name: Build agromet advisory platforms delivering weather-indexed farming guidance via digital channels
definition: Combine weather forecasts with agricultural knowledge to deliver crop-specific advisories.

measure_name: Implement real-time environmental monitoring using earth observation and ground sensor networks
definition: Satellite imagery, drone data, ground sensors for continuous monitoring.

measure_name: Build decision support systems for anticipatory action integrating multiple data sources
definition: Platforms combining exposure databases, sensor networks, forecasts and hazard models for proactive decision-making.

measure_name: Deploy flood forecasting models using hydrological and meteorological data
definition: Operationalize numerical weather prediction and hydrological models converting observation data into flood forecasts.

measure_name: Deploy crowdsourced disaster reporting and social media monitoring for situational awareness
definition: Citizen reports and community-based sensors supplementing formal monitoring.

measure_name: Establish verified official communication protocols to counter misinformation during crises
definition: Institutional frameworks for official messaging and content verification during emergencies.

measure_name: Adopt Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) for standardized multi-channel warnings
definition: International CAP standard ensuring alerts are machine-readable across SMS, cell broadcast, TV and radio.

measure_name: Create open data standards and sharing agreements for hazard and exposure data across agencies
definition: Interoperability of hazard, vulnerability and exposure datasets across agencies.

measure_name: Implement sovereign parametric insurance using satellite and sensor triggers for rapid payouts
definition: Sovereign risk pools with automatic payouts triggered by measurable parameters.

measure_name: Deploy index-based agricultural insurance using earth observation data for farmer-level payouts
definition: Payouts triggered by satellite-observed rainfall, vegetation indices or temperature thresholds.

measure_name: Design Cat DDO trigger mechanisms linked to digital connectivity and data infrastructure
definition: Connect data infrastructure to Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option trigger design.

measure_name: Deploy rapid post-disaster damage and loss assessment using earth observation and remote sensing
definition: Satellite imagery, drone surveys and crowdsourced data to accelerate damage assessment for insurance claims and relief allocation.

measure_name: Deploy rapid post-disaster damage and loss assessment using earth observation and remote sensing (infrastructure)
definition: Same capabilities used for infrastructure damage mapping - roads, bridges, power lines, telecom - enabling faster repair prioritization.

measure_name: Design oversight and transparency frameworks for parametric trigger calibration and basis risk
definition: Ensure trigger thresholds do not systematically exclude vulnerable populations.

measure_name: Develop governance frameworks for disputed satellite data and trigger verification post-disaster
definition: Independent arbitration when parametric trigger outcomes are contested.

measure_name: Harden telecom towers and base stations against physical hazards
definition: Reinforce towers for wind and seismic resistance, elevate equipment above flood lines, deploy hardened shelters.

measure_name: Build submarine cable redundancy through diverse routing
definition: Second and third submarine cable connections with geographically diverse routes.

measure_name: Design ring and mesh fiber topology for national network resilience
definition: Configure national fiber in ring or mesh topologies rather than linear spans so a break does not isolate downstream users.

measure_name: Establish emergency power backup for critical digital infrastructure
definition: Battery banks, diesel and solar generators, hybrid renewable backup for cell towers, data centers and IXPs.

measure_name: Upgrade and harden government data centers for disaster resilience
definition: Climate-resilient design - raised floors, flood barriers, redundant cooling, backup power, geographic separation.

measure_name: Deploy climate-resilient fiber-to-the-premises in hazard-prone areas
definition: Last-mile fiber designed for local hazard exposure - aerial vs underground by flood and wind risk, armored cable in landslide zones.

measure_name: Diversify equipment vendor dependencies for telecom supply chain resilience
definition: Reduce reliance on single equipment suppliers.

measure_name: Use digital twins and simulation models for infrastructure stress testing
definition: Virtual replicas of critical infrastructure to model failure scenarios and prioritize reinforcement.

measure_name: Implement GIS-based infrastructure mapping for resilience planning and asset management
definition: Digital maps of critical networks overlaid with hazard exposure to identify vulnerabilities.

measure_name: Monitor climate vulnerability of digital infrastructure using geospatial and climate projection data
definition: Assess current and projected climate risks to telecom and digital infrastructure.

measure_name: Deploy smart grid and digital energy management systems for resilient power supply
definition: Digital monitoring and automated control for electricity grids to maintain power supply to critical digital infrastructure.

measure_name: Establish infrastructure sharing and emergency roaming policies between telecom operators
definition: Regulatory frameworks requiring operators to share towers, fiber and spectrum during emergencies.

measure_name: Develop national emergency telecommunications plans and spectrum sharing mandates
definition: National plans governing telecom during emergencies - priority routing, temporary spectrum allocation, emergency roaming.

measure_name: Incorporate resilience standards and climate screening in telecom infrastructure procurement
definition: Embed resilience requirements in bidding documents and PPP contracts.

measure_name: Develop national fiber pooling and open access policies for resilient connectivity
definition: Shared use of fiber including OPGW on power lines through regulatory frameworks.

measure_name: Establish national cybersecurity frameworks and CERTs for critical digital infrastructure
definition: Computer Emergency Response Teams and cybersecurity standards for critical infrastructure operators.

measure_name: Ensure emergency coordination platforms have offline capability and backup power
definition: Crisis coordination platforms must function when connectivity and power are degraded.

measure_name: Build resilient ICT and redundant communications for emergency operations centers
definition: Redundant communication links, backup power and hardened facilities for EOCs.

measure_name: Pre-position satellite communications for government use during terrestrial network failure
definition: Satellite equipment and service agreements for activation when terrestrial telecom is destroyed.

measure_name: Establish disaster recovery sites and government cloud resilience for continuity of digital services
definition: Geographically separated backup data centers and cloud so government digital services survive localized disasters.

measure_name: Ensure health facility ICT systems have backup power and connectivity for continuity
definition: Hospitals and clinics with backup power, satellite or mesh connectivity, and local data caching.

measure_name: Build digital coordination platforms for multi-agency emergency response and aid logistics
definition: Needs assessment, resource tracking and response coordination on shared platforms.

measure_name: Deploy telemedicine and digital health platforms for continued healthcare access during crises
definition: Remote consultations and health data continuity when facilities are damaged.

measure_name: Deploy precision agriculture tools combining sensors, GPS, and analytics for climate-resilient farming
definition: GPS mapping, remote sensors, drones and analytics to optimize water, fertilizer and seed inputs.

measure_name: Deploy digital agriculture extension services for advisory and market access
definition: Mobile platforms delivering market prices, weather-indexed planting advice and pest alerts.

measure_name: Implement AI and satellite-based measurement, reporting, and verification for climate commitments
definition: Satellite analysis to independently verify emission reductions or land use change.

measure_name: Deploy digital platforms for emergency cash mobilization via mobile money
definition: Rapid emergency cash distribution through existing mobile money during and after crises.

measure_name: Deploy digital education continuity platforms for remote learning during crises
definition: Online and offline-capable learning platforms so education continues when schools are closed.

measure_name: Optimize humanitarian supply chain and last-mile aid delivery using digital logistics platforms
definition: Tracking aid shipments, warehouse management, fleet routing and delivery verification.

measure_name: Design digital inclusion safeguards ensuring crisis response reaches populations without connectivity or devices
definition: Alternative non-digital channels for all digitally-delivered crisis services.

measure_name: Establish digital accessibility standards for persons with disabilities in crisis services
definition: Accessibility standards ensuring emergency apps, warning systems and registration platforms are usable.

measure_name: Establish data protection standards for emergency beneficiary targeting and cross-agency data sharing
definition: Rules governing personal data collected during emergencies.

measure_name: Develop interoperability standards across humanitarian and government digital response systems
definition: Government disaster platforms, UN tools and NGO systems can exchange data.

measure_name: Build misinformation rapid-response protocols for crisis communications
definition: SOPs for monitoring and countering misinformation during active emergency response.

measure_name: Address algorithmic accountability in emergency resource allocation systems
definition: Audit and oversight frameworks for algorithmic systems prioritizing emergency resource distribution.

measure_name: Build digital business continuity capacity for SMEs and micro-enterprises
definition: Cloud backup, digital inventory management, cyber insurance access and continuity planning for small firms.

measure_name: Issue digital identity credentials to displaced and crisis-affected populations lacking documentation
definition: Identity verification for refugees, IDPs and people who lost documents.

measure_name: Design social registries with dynamic expansion capability for rapid shock response
definition: Registry architectures that rapidly scale enrollment during emergencies.

measure_name: Deploy digital disease surveillance and epidemic intelligence platforms
definition: Disease detection, case reporting, contact tracing and epidemiological analytics.

measure_name: Build digital food security early warning and anticipatory action systems
definition: Food price monitoring, nutrition surveillance, crop forecasting and market data triggering anticipatory action.

measure_name: Develop urban geospatial risk data platforms integrating hazard, exposure, and vulnerability layers
definition: Hazard maps, building footprints, population density and infrastructure vulnerability in one platform.

measure_name: Deploy AI and machine learning models for disaster nowcasting and short-range prediction
definition: ML-based nowcasting for sub-hourly, hyperlocal disaster prediction.

measure_name: Deploy AI-automated building-level damage assessment using satellite and drone imagery
definition: Computer vision on post-disaster imagery for automated building-by-building damage classification.

measure_name: Use anonymized mobile network data for real-time population displacement tracking during disasters
definition: Anonymized call detail records to track population movements during disasters.

measure_name: Support community-owned mesh networks and locally maintained connectivity infrastructure
definition: Communities build and maintain their own connectivity using mesh networks and solar-powered WiFi.

measure_name: Deploy SCADA and IoT monitoring systems for water utility resilience
definition: Supervisory control, automated meter reading, hydraulic modeling and real-time leak detection for water utilities.

measure_name: Install digital instrumentation and remote monitoring for dam safety
definition: IoT sensors, SCADA, automated data acquisition and early warning alerts for dam structural integrity.

measure_name: Implement digital platforms for port and maritime supply chain resilience
definition: Maritime Single Windows, Port Community Systems and Port Management Systems.

measure_name: Establish sector-specific OT cybersecurity frameworks for energy, water, and transport systems
definition: Cybersecurity standards and incident response for operational technology in power grids, water SCADA and port systems.

measure_name: Develop cybersecurity governance and data protection frameworks for health sector digital systems
definition: Health-specific cybersecurity including patient data protection and ransomware preparedness for hospitals.

measure_name: Establish regulatory frameworks for LEO satellite connectivity as emergency backup
definition: Policies for governments to contract low-earth orbit satellite services as standby backup.

measure_name: Develop sovereign cloud and data residency policies for government continuity
definition: Policies on where government data resides and who controls it, including data embassy arrangements.

measure_name: Establish regional frameworks for cross-border digital resilience cooperation
definition: Regional mutual aid for digital emergencies including cross-border emergency roaming and regional CERT coordination.

measure_name: Integrate digital climate risk analytics into public financial management systems
definition: Disaster loss databases and climate risk projections embedded into government FMIS.

measure_name: Develop and regularly test government ICT business continuity and disaster recovery plans
definition: Continuity plans covering technical failover and offline service delivery, created, maintained and exercised.

measure_name: Provide emergency connectivity to displaced populations in humanitarian settings
definition: Internet access, WiFi hotspots and device access in camps, settlements and host communities.

measure_name: Deploy digital tools for climate-adapted livestock management and pastoral early warning
definition: Satellite-based pasture monitoring, livestock tracking, veterinary telemedicine and pastoral migration advisory.

measure_name: Deploy rapid digital household welfare tracking for post-disaster needs assessment
definition: Mobile phone surveys, CATI and SMS monitoring for rapid household-level needs identification after disasters.
